description: Classifies the user's complete original request as help, action, correction or unsupported, including correct, undo and reverse requests and phrases such as how do I and actions such as create a sales invoice, add a customer, read, update, delete, email or batch. Accepted actions return a workflow and routeToken; help and correction results do not issue a transactional route token. Strict authorization binds the token to host-signed original-request metadata and fails closed when that metadata is missing or mismatched. Preview and confirmation are separate safeguards.

companyName.description: Optional selected company; binds the issued routeToken to that exact company. Legacy calls without it bind on first transactional use.

connectionRef.description: Opaque Red connection reference returned by brc_confirm_company_connection. Pass this exact value on every later tool call when the MCP client rotates session ids (for example Vibe/Mistral). Keep reusing the same connectionRef after successful tool calls — do not start a new connection because a lookup returned empty or partial data. It is not an API key and does not contain credentials.

message.description: The user's complete original message to classify, for example add a customer or how do I add a customer.
